data.use_of_proceeds: Repay approximately $42.6 million of outstanding subordinated notes and preferred stock, and provide capital to subsidiary bank.

tranches.benchmark: Three-Month Term SOFR plus 222 basis points
tranches.pricing_quote: From and including October 1, 2031, to, but excluding, the maturity date or the date of earlier redemption (the "floating rate period"), the Notes will bear interest at a floating rate per annum equal to the Three-Month Term SOFR, or such other Benchmark rate, plus 222 basis points for each quarterly interest period during the floating rate period
